meta.description: Test whether cell-type proportions or composition changed between conditions in single-cell data using Milo, scCODA, sccomp, and propeller.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All numeric claims in this report are tied to saved fresh logs or are explicitly identified as source text.

practice_boundaries.detail: The tested workflows compare groups of samples and do not diagnose, triage, or prescribe for an individual.

methodological_ground.detail: The live propeller and Milo runs used sample-level replication and retained the Skill's simplex and confounding cautions.

code_usability.detail: Two code blocks printed in SKILL.md fail as written: the Milo block calls distinct() without loading dplyr, and the scCODA block calls tf.random.set_seed without importing tensorflow as tf. The shipped examples repair these imports, but they do not make the inline blocks runnable.

functional_suitability.note: The method coverage and substantive guidance are broad, but two advertised inline execution paths fail directly and sccomp remains unexecuted.

reliability.note: Good replicate, power, reference, and common-error guidance; direct snippets lack the imports required to reach their stated recovery logic.

performance_context.note: The 192-line Skill is focused and avoids duplicated user-guide procedures, though results and implementation details are mixed in the main file.

agent_usability.note: Decision guidance is clear, but an agent following the displayed blocks rather than examples gets undeclared-name failures.

human_usability.note: Natural triggers and practical error rows are strong; exact code paths are not equally discoverable or trustworthy.

security.note: No secrets or destructive operations appear. The snippets do not preflight metadata, cell labels, or confounded designs programmatically.

maintainability.note: Sections and runnable examples are organized, but the examples and inline blocks have drifted on required imports.

agent_specific.note: Triggers, stop conditions, and stochasticity guidance are useful; the source-versus-example divergence breaks dependable agent execution.

key_strengths: Fresh propeller regression recovered the planted NK-only composition change with the corrected logit-default interpretation.
The Milo power and adjusted-model cautions reproduced on the same synthetic donor-level data.
The n=1 guard and replicate guidance behaved correctly in a fresh propeller run.
The joint DE and DA stress run remained scientifically cautious when its constructed mixing claim was not demonstrated.

recommendations.title: Repair two direct inline code blocks
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md's Milo block omits dplyr while using distinct(), and its scCODA block omits import tensorflow as tf while using tf.random.set_seed(). Both fail as printed.
recommendations.root_cause: The examples contain the required imports but the corresponding inline blocks were changed independently.
recommendations.fix: Add library(dplyr) to the inline Milo library block and import tensorflow as tf to the inline scCODA block. Execute both inline paths, not only examples, on the saved synthetic fixture before re-audit.

recommendations.title: Make sccomp verification executable
recommendations.problem: sccomp remains recommended but is documented as unexecuted because CmdStan is absent.
recommendations.root_cause: The installation command names CmdStan but does not give a tested, complete executable path in this environment.
recommendations.fix: Either add and run a complete version-pinned CmdStan/sccomp verification route, or narrow the Skill's claim until that route is tested.
